title: Catalog onboarding heuristics and launch blurbs (WIP)
content:
Purpose: working doc for the partner catalog onboarding flow (catalog tile copy, SKU heuristics, technical acceptance checklist) — focus on making decisions we can hand to product + legal for final sign-off. This is intentionally rough; trying to capture edge-cases we keep bumping into and provide copy variants for quick A/B tests.

Quick summary / outcomes we want:
- A one-line tile blurb (20–40 chars) + 1-paragraph description for the marketplace card.
- Clear SKU/entitlement mapping rules for trial vs paid offers.
- List of minimal technical/nonfunctional acceptance gates before go-live.
- Localization/region gating heuristics for cloud vendor requirements.
- Open questions for Legal and Billing.

Tile copy candidates (short, aim for clarity + benefit):
1) "Redwood Inference — Production LLM API"  (too long?)
2) "Low-latency LLM inference for apps"
3) "Scale LLMs: predictable latency & costs"
4) "High-throughput LLM runtime (SLA-ready)"

Longer description (approx 1–2 sentences; option sets to test):
A) "Redwood Inference provides a production-grade inference platform with predictable latency, autoscaling GPU capacity, and enterprise controls for private or hosted deployments. Ship LLM features faster while keeping cost and reliability under control."
B) "Deploy and serve large language models across hosted, dedicated, and private modes. Built-in observability, canaries, and intelligent batching reduce cost while meeting SLAs."
C) "Bring your models or use curated open models. Redwood optimizes serving kernels, caching, and routing to deliver consistent performance at lower cost — includes rollout controls and audit logs for regulated workloads."

CTA variations:
- "Start free trial" (needs trial SKU mapping)
- "Request demo & pricing" (enterprise flow)
- "Try sandbox (no-credit)"

SKU / Entitlement heuristics (draft rules):
- Offer types: Free Sandbox (0 tokens, 14-day access); Trial Credit (20k token credit, auto-expire 30 days); Paid Metered (per-token billing via cloud marketplace); Reserved (monthly commit, Dedicated).
- Map tile CTA to: Free Sandbox -> "Try sandbox"; Trial Credit -> "Start free trial"; Reserved -> "Contact sales".
- Billing SKUs: follow cloud vendor prefixing rule (VENDOR.REDWOOD.INFERENCE.[OFFER_TYPE]. For example AWS: aws.redwood.inference.trial-v1). See linked_artifacts for mapping PR.
- Promo codes / partner rebates: must be attached to billing SKU metadata; legal sign-off required.

Technical acceptance checklist (minimal):
- Image/asset specs: 1200x628 PNG for hero tile + 128x128 icon. Verify no logo/font violations.
- Integration test: provisioning via vendor marketplace completes end-to-end (JIRA-1248).
- API key handshake: customer can call hosted API endpoint from approved region. Verify successfulCreateToken + first request < 2s median for small payloads (sanity test).
- Entitlement enforcement: marketplace-provisioned account gets correct SKU flags (trial vs paid) and token expiration is honored.
- Security: KMS is required for Private offers. Confirm KMS integration guide included in partner docs.
- Observability: Marketplace trial accounts must surface cost & latency metrics in Console within 24 hours of provisioning (stub data acceptable for sandbox).

Launch gating matrix (green/yellow/red):
- Green: tile assets provided, SKU mapping reviewed, legal & billing have signed off on offer terms, basic integration tests pass, launch date scheduled with vendor.
- Yellow: creative or billing SKU in review, some test failures flakier than expected, risk of rollback flagged.
- Red: security/KMS or data residency issues unresolved, SLA language not approved, or vendor rejects SKU mapping. No go.

Localization & region heuristics (practical rules):
- If partner requests availability in EU region(s) -> require data residency checkbox + audit log export enabled.
- For APAC -> validate cloud vendor regions mapping and latency guardrails, if deployable to on-prem we need separate Private offer flows.
- Localized tile copy: only translate short blurb + CTA. Description stays in EN until legal approves translated ISV terms.

Open questions / blockers for Legal & Billing:
- Can we surface per-token price on tile, or must it be omitted until customer chooses plan? (Ask Legal: Confluence page id in linked_artifacts).
- How do we represent metered minimums for marketplace billing (some vendors require trial->paid conversion logic) — need exact wording for T&C.
- Promotional SKUs: is marketplace rebate applied as separate SKU or via billing adjustment? Need billing ops confirmation.

Operational notes / rollout plan (short):
- Week 0: finalize tile assets + copy variant selection. Assign: Julian (creative) + Priya (copy).
- Week 1: create billing SKUs, run integration test, get legal pre-review. Owner: Ethan (billing).
- Week 2: vendor submission, respond to vendor feedback, schedule preview launch. Owner: Samira.
- Week 3: soft-launch for alpha partners, monitor metrics, collect feedback.

Risk & mitigation quick list:
- Risk: Trial abuse (scripts minting tokens). Mitigation: rate-limit trials + require email verification + CAPTCHA during registration for sandbox.
- Risk: Unexpected latency for long-context models. Mitigation: automatic fallback policy to cost-tiered variant + clear notes on model context length in listing copy.
- Risk: Rejection by vendor on naming conventions. Mitigation: pre-validate SKU names with vendor marketplace docs and a short preflight checklist.

Notes-to-self (fragments):
- Need to surface example request/response in tile details — short code snippet with token usage example. Keep under 6 lines.
- Add small matrix mapping model families -> recommended quantization / offering (for Optimize team input).
- Keep one variant that emphasizes "private deployment" for regulated customers (callout in description).

Decision log (initial):
- Decided: CTA "Start free trial" kept for Trial Credit offers. (Samira, 2025-11-05)
- Decided: Localization limited to tile + CTA until translations approved. (Julian, 2025-12-16)

Next actions (assignments):
- Julian: mock tile images + select final short-blurb by 2026-03-10.
- Priya: polish long description variants and add 2 compliance-focused blurbs by 2026-03-12.
- Ethan: finalize billing SKU prefixes and run end-to-end provisioning test (JIRA-1248) by 2026-03-05.
- Samira: consolidate legal questions and ping Legal owner (Marin Ortega) in Slack thread.

Reference snippets (copy fallback if we need compressed wording for small tiles):
- "Production LLM serving with SLA-ready latency and cost controls."
- "Ship LLM features with predictable performance and enterprise controls."

Thread history & provenance: rough notes pulled from vendor preflight meeting on 2025-10-30, internal launch sync 2025-11-06, and billing integration run 2026-02-20. Expect this doc to be iterated rapidly; canonical source for now is this file until Confluence draft is created.

---
End of doc — feedback welcome in-line or drop comments in Slack #pm-marketplace-onboarding.
